name: WebExtract (Remote)
description: Connects to the hosted WebExtract MCP endpoint. page_markdown returns clean Markdown for a public URL; extract_url returns Markdown plus structured JSON (product and price, tables, article metadata). The first 20 calls a day per caller IP need no key; after that the endpoint asks for payment by x402 USDC, or accepts an API key bought with prepaid Stripe credits. Sandbox benchmark on 10 public pages: markdown 38/40, extract 40/40 (https://webextract.dev/benchmark).
